description: Use this when the user has an uploaded PDF (document_id, or upload_id from create_upload_link) and a recipient address and wants it posted by ordinary or registered mail; registered mail is international registered mail with tracking and signature on delivery; "certified" letters, Einschreiben, lettre recommandée and carta certificada mean this here (not a US certified-mail product). Creates a draft with the exact total in the user's currency. Nothing is sent or charged; call send_letter only after the user confirms. Every envelope carries our company return address, so the user's own address belongs in the document. A US Letter PDF to a recipient outside the US, Canada and US territories needs the user's paper choice (paper_size, same price): without it the draft says paper_choice_required. Needs the user's account.

color.description: "bw" = black and white, "color" = colour printing (costs more per page). Default "bw".

document_id.description: The PDF to post: document_id from upload_document or compose_letter, e.g. doc_2h7k9m4q8x1v3c6b0n5p. Pass document_id or upload_id.

duplex.description: true = print on both sides of the paper (fewer sheets, so a lighter letter); false = one side only. Default false.

envelope.description: "DL" (220×110 mm, letter folded twice), "C5" (229×162 mm, folded once) or "C4" (324×229 mm, flat). Omit to use the smallest envelope that holds the sheets (recommended); one too small for the page count is refused.

paper_size.description: Only for a US Letter PDF to a recipient outside US, CA, PR, VI, GU, AS, MP (the US, Canada and US territories): "a4" = shrink to A4 (recommended), "us_letter" = keep US Letter. Ask the user; same price. Ignored otherwise (A4 PDFs print on A4, US Letter PDFs to those countries on US Letter). No default: omit until the user has chosen.

recipient.description: Recipient's postal address, printed on the envelope. Ask the user for missing fields.

company.description: Recipient's company or organisation, e.g. Example GmbH. Optional.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, FR or US.

line1.description: Street and house number, or PO box, e.g. Hauptstraße 5.

line2.description: Optional extra address line: c/o, apartment, floor or building, e.g. Apt 4B.

name.description: Recipient's name: a person, or a department such as Customer Service when writing to a company, e.g. Erika Mustermann.

postal_code.description: Postcode / ZIP code, e.g. 10115 or 94105. Required in countries that use postcodes.

region.description: State, province or region. Required for recipients in AE, AS, AU, BR, CA, CN, CO, CR, ES, FM, HK, HN, ID, IN, IQ, IT, JM, JP, KN, KR, KY, MH, MP, MX, NR, PF, PG, PW, RU, SO, SV, TW, US, VE, VI, VN (without it the draft is refused: INVALID_ADDRESS, fields.region); omit where addresses have none, e.g. DE, FR or GB. The code in US, CA, AU and BR, e.g. CA (California) or ON (Ontario); elsewhere the name or its usual abbreviation, e.g. Madrid (ES) or RM (Rome, IT).

registered.description: true = registered mail: tracking number and signature on delivery, for an extra fee (also what "certified" letters, Einschreiben, lettre recommandée and carta certificada mean here; not a US certified-mail product). false = ordinary mail. Default false.

upload_id.description: upload_id from create_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the PDF on that page. Pass document_id or upload_id.

name: create_letter
title: Create letter draft
